description: This file defines several reusable React UI components including layout components (Container), UI elements (Button, Input, Badge), header (AppHeader), and notification (Toast). It also includes utility functions like classNames for conditional class management. The components are styled with Tailwind CSS classes and are intended for use across a React-based frontend application.

methods.name: classNames
methods.description: Utility function to combine multiple class name strings conditionally.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: A layout component that centers and constrains content width.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A styled container component with rounded corners and shadow.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: Component for rendering a header section inside a card, showing title and optional subtitle.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A customizable button component supporting different variants, sizes, and states.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A labeled input field component with support for error messages and autoComplete.

methods.name: Badge
methods.description: A small badge component with different tone styles to indicate status.

methods.name: AppHeader
methods.description: Header component displaying logo, navigation links, and user profile/actions.

methods.name: Toast
methods.description: Notification component displaying success, error, or info messages.
